title: Detection Is Not Enough: Reasoning Traces as Testable Program Hypotheses
abstract: arXiv:2610.30200v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: When a language model is deployed, no reference solution exists, so the reasoning trace it writes is the only evidence for judging its answer. The reference-free substitutes each fail differently: self-assessment degrades the answer it was meant to protect, sampling agreement measures stability rather than correctness, and perturbation studies read the expected answer off a human-written template, grading a model rather than a trace. We ask how far a single trace can be verified with no reference solution, no judge model and no weight update, and find, for a frozen LLaMA-2-7B-chat on GSM8K, that detection is not what limits such a pipeline. Checking a trace against itself reaches an AUROC of 0.741 and stops there for a structural reason: two thirds of wrong traces state no false equation, having executed a mistaken plan correctly, and on wrong-plan failures the detector flags a wrong trace less often than a right one. translated_title: 检测并不足够：作为可测试程序假设的推理轨迹
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.30200v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：当语言模型被部署时，并不存在参考解答，因此模型写出的推理轨迹是判断其答案的唯一证据。各类无参考的替代方案各有不同的失败方式：自我评估会损害它本想保护的答案；采样一致性衡量的是稳定性而非正确性；而扰动研究则是从人工编写的模板中读取预期答案，评估的对象是模型而非轨迹本身。我们探究在没有参考解答、没有评判模型、也没有权重更新的条件下，单条推理轨迹能够被验证到什么程度，并发现：对于在 GSM8K 数据集上使用的冻结 LLaMA-2-7B-chat 模型，限制此类验证流程的并非检测能力。将轨迹与自身进行检验可以达到 0.741 的 AUROC，并因一个结构性原因而止步于此：三分之二的错误轨迹并未陈述任何错误的等式——它们正确地执行了一个错误的计划；而且在“错误计划”导致的失败案例中，检测器标记错误轨迹的频率反而低于标记正确轨迹的频率。基于候选派生的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究发现，在没有参考解答、评判模型和权重更新的条件下，对大模型推理轨迹的自检验存在结构性上限——多数错误轨迹源于正确执行了错误的计划，因此仅仅依靠检测并不足够，应将推理轨迹视为可测试的程序假设。
en_tdlr: The paper shows that self-checking an LLM's reasoning trace without any reference, judge, or weight update hits a structural ceiling—most wrong traces correctly execute a mistaken plan—so detection alone is not enough and reasoning traces must be treated as testable program hypotheses.
